sources: recreation.gov search API campsite catalog for 231849 (32 sites)
Esri World_Imagery around the site points

hookups.source: recreation.gov 231849 notice ('There are no electric hookups available'; 'Please fill your trailer prior to arriving. Trailers are not allowed to fill at any hydrants') + catalog (all 32 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 32 sites in three loops, 7 of them pull-throughs, including two host sites (018 and 019 in loop B). Catalogued lengths run 20-90 ft and nearly every site takes 23 ft or more (only 009, 20 ft, does not); the FS caps RVs at 45 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('There are 32 sites, 7 of which are pull-through.'; 'Maximum RV lenth is 45'.') + recreation.gov catalog 231849 (sites 001-032; Max Vehicle Length 20-90; '018 Host', '019 Host'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water spigots (no trailer filling at the hydrants); picnic table and fire ring at each site; bear-proof trash containers.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('Vault toilets'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'; 'Each site has a picnic table, fire ring'; 'bear proof trash containers') + recreation.gov 231849 (amenities: Vault Toilets, Water Spigot, Self Pay Station), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('Seasons of Use: Memorial Day to Labor Day'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov or 1-877-444-6777 (2026 season May 23 - Aug 31; 2027 May 28 - Sep 6); booking closes 4 days before arrival. Ten public sites are catalogued not reservable, so first-come sites may be available but are not guaranteed. A reserved site is held until check-out time the day after arrival, then released as a no-show to first-come campers. 14 nights in any 30 consecutive days, strictly enforced. Six people and one vehicle included per single site; up to 8 people and 2 vehicles at $10 a night each extra.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('Reservations can be made through Recreation.gov or by calling 1-877-444-6777.') + recreation.gov 231849 (rules: maxStay 14 nights Rolling 30 Days, reservationCutOff 4; notices on first-come sites, no-shows, stay limit and per-site people/vehicles; rates: Peak Season 2026-05-23 to 2026-08-31, 2027-05-28 to 2027-09-06; catalog: 20 sites reservable, 12 not, two of them host sites), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Single site $29 a night, double $58; extra person (over 6) or second vehicle $10 a night; day use $12.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('Single Site: $29 per night / Double Site: $58 per night'; 'Day Use: $12 per day') + recreation.gov 231849 notice ($10.00 extra per person after 6 / 2nd vehicle), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior and Access pass holders get 50% off single sites only, for the site they occupy.

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/riogrande/recreation/aspen-glade-campground ('Interagency Senior/Access Recreation Passes provide a 50% discount to single campsites ONLY.'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS (Rio Grande NF, Conejos Peak Ranger District), concessionaire-run (PMC), on the Conejos River off CO-17 about 15 miles west of Antonito, at 8,500 ft. Three loops: A and B lightly wooded with ponderosa pine, C heavily wooded with spruce, aspen and fir along the river. Gold Medal fly-fishing-only water starts 1/4 mile upstream; Sheep Creek Trail nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov campground/rates/catalog: confirmed 32 sites, 7 pull-throughs, max RV 45 ft, no hookups, vault toilets, potable water, Memorial Day-Labor Day, rec.gov, $29.
